raw_segments.text: Flames glided in the river, small green flames, red flames, white flames, pursuing, overtaking,
joining, crossing each other, then separating slowly or hastily.
The traffic of the great city went on in the deepening night upon the sleepless river.
There was nothing else to do till the end of the flood.
But it was only after a long silence when he said, in a hesitating voice,
I suppose you fellows remember I did once turn freshwater sailor for a bit,
that we knew we were fated before the ebb began to run
to hear about one of Marlowe's inconclusive experiences.
